title: Anniversary Security Review of Active C&I Contracts
content:
*Scope: Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts. Subject: anniversary security review.*

The anniversary security review re-sizes the security held on an active contract once a year, and the business's authorized signatory remits any amount the review requests from the business's own account. The review never refunds security, because a held deposit is refunded only after the contract closes.

## When the amount is settled

The review amount is fixed only after every block line posted in the review window carries a rebill credit for any part of it billed above the block price in force for its cycle.

The review amount is not worked out until every index line posted in the review window carries a rebill credit for any part of it billed above the index price the contract allows.

Before the review amount is worked out, every contract of the same business that closed during its term by a final bill or by another supplier's enrollment must carry its early termination fee line.

## Remittance: `remit_review_deposit_f4180914`

The remittance is the customer's own action. The agent unlocks `remit_review_deposit_f4180914` and hands it over, and the customer themselves, through the business's authorized signatory, runs it.

**Capability.** One run records one security deposit receipt of the stated dollar amount against the reviewed contract, remitted from the business's own bank account and dated today, carrying the months of supply cost and the commercial credit grade it was sized on. The security Beacon Ridge holds on the contract rises by exactly that amount, and the receipt then appears among the contract's security deposits. Nothing else on the contract changes.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `cni_contract_id` | the commercial and industrial contract number of the reviewed contract, as shown on the contract record returned by the contract lookup | contract number |
| `amount_usd` | the dollar amount remitted | US dollars, a positive number rounded half up to 2 decimal places; stored exactly as passed |
| `deposit_months` | the months of estimated supply cost the reviewed security represents | a whole number of months |
| `credit_grade_basis` | the commercial credit grade written on the receipt, copied from the grade recorded on the contract's existing security deposit receipt | one of the values below |

Values of `credit_grade_basis`: `A` when the existing receipt records grade A; `B` when it records grade B; `C` when it records grade C; `not_rated` when it records not rated; `""` (empty) only when the contract has no existing receipt to copy a grade from.

**Return.** A confirmation carrying `cni_deposit_id` (the reference number of the new receipt), `cni_contract_id` (the contract secured), `amount_usd` (2 decimal places), `deposit_months` (a whole number), `posted_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD) and a status that is always "recorded", meaning the deposit now counts toward the security held.
